notes.title: 🧩🎲🧩 Important Changes to Bundle Discounts on Steam 🧩🎲🧩
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43869666/49a4411e797b9d961928db1a31f10ccaecccc68c.png[/img]
[quote]
[i][b]Dear Players,[/b][/i]

[i]In accordance with the new Steam regulations, we are required to limit the discount on all our bundles to 10% in order to avoid increasing the base price of our games (currently 2 USD without a discount). If the discount exceeds this limit, the bundles will no longer appear in the Steam store and will be unavailable for purchase. This change is essential to maintain accessibility to our bundles.

Please note that the discount on a bundle may fluctuate based on the number of discounts applied to the individual games within it. Be sure to stay updated on our discount announcements to take advantage of the best deals!

Thank you for your support![/i]

[i][b]Best Regards

Quantum Quiver Games[/b][/i]

[/quote]
